source_evidence: Leveraged loans may not be as easily purchased or sold as publicly-traded securities. In addition, leveraged loans typically have a long settlement period, meaning it could take the fund a long time to get its money after selling its investment.
answer: Liquidity risk is the difficulty of selling an investment promptly and getting the cash from the sale. Leveraged loans may be harder to buy or sell than publicly traded securities, and their settlement can take a long time. As a result, a fund that holds many leveraged loans may face challenges if it needs to sell investments quickly; this could affect the value of your investment in the fund.
